name: Alarm-HUB
description: Alarm-HUB is a standalone multi-user alarm service with manual alarms, mobile API access, optional WebComm Calendar Sync integration, and optional direct WebComm import. PostgreSQL is embedded by default, so a normal Unraid installation requires only one container. Persistent application and database data are stored below /config.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent Alarm-HUB data, including the embedded PostgreSQL database and generated application secret.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the Alarm-HUB WebUI.

variables.name: Database Mode
variables.description: embedded = integrated PostgreSQL database (recommended); external = use your own PostgreSQL server.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Optional in embedded mode: when left empty Alarm-HUB creates and persists a strong secret under /config. Set and keep a fixed value for external/managed deployments if desired.

variables.name: Secure Session Cookies
variables.description: Default false for direct local HTTP access in Unraid. Set true when Alarm-HUB is published through an HTTPS reverse proxy.
